summary_bullets: Clarify in the /design plan-review prompt that the plan describes post-merge state so reviewers stop reporting current-code gaps the plan already proposes to fix.
Document the plan-vs-current-state invariant beside the renderer contract and lock it in with the existing archetype×vendor harness substring check.
commit_message:
fix(design): plan-review prompt distinguishes proposed vs current state

External reviewers were instructed to read the repo before the plan lands, but nothing said the plan describes the future tree—so they filed accurate-but-wrong findings against current code. Add a single shared heredoc paragraph, document the invariant in render-plan-review-prompt.md, and assert the substring across all vendors and archetypes in test-plan-review-prompt.sh.
